controls.scrollHint: Scroll / Pinch or Click Any Phase

1.title: Phase 1: Full Equilateral Triangle → Step-by-Step Sierpinski
1.desc: Starts with a complete equilateral triangle (N=0) and carves out the Sierpinski Gasket one recursion step at a time (N=1→8, D ≈ 1.585).

2.title: Phase 2: 3D Sierpinski Pyramid
2.desc: The 2D gasket tilts and extrudes into a raymarched 3D Sierpinski Tetrahedron with four-fold recursive cavities.

3.title: Phase 3: 3D Menger Sponge
3.desc: Tetrahedral folds morph into the orthogonal cubic cross-tunnels of a 3D Menger Sponge (D = ln 20 / ln 3 ≈ 2.727).

4.title: Phase 4: 3D Mandelbulb
4.desc: Cubic tunnels warp into spherical-coordinate 3D Mandelbulb filaments before approaching a flat terrace edge.

5.tag: STAGE I → II // FACET PLANE BRIDGE
5.title: Phase 5: Fractal Terrace Facet Plane
5.desc: Camera lands on a single flat terrace facet etched with polykite seams that lock into the Einstein Hat monotile.

6.tag: STAGE II // APERIODIC CONWAY GAME OF LIFE
6.title: Phase 6: Einstein Hat 0/1 Cellular Automaton
6.desc: Exact edge-to-edge 13-sided Einstein Hat monotiles interlock with zero gaps, switching between binary 0 and 1 states via an aperiodic Conway's Game of Life rule.

7.title: Phase 7: Standard 3D Prismatic Einstein Hat Extrusion
7.desc: The gap-free 2D Einstein Hat plane extrudes directly along the Z-axis into a standard 3D prismatic slab landscape of 0 and 1 columns.

8.title: Phase 8: 3D Skyscraper City Skyline
8.desc: The extruded Einstein Hat prisms rise into an oblique 3D high-rise skyscraper city skyline with illuminated curtain-wall windows.

9.tag: STAGE II → III // TRUE 3D EINSTEIN MONOTILE
9.title: Phase 9: True 3D Aperiodic Monotile & 3D Text
9.desc: True 3D aperiodic polyhedra (Schmitt–Conway–Danzer twisted bipyramids & 3D Einstein text) where harsh 0/1 bits dissolve back into continuous nature (≈, ∞).

10.title: Phase 10: Coastline & Bathymetric Charts
10.desc: Binary boundaries melt into continuous orbital coastlines overlaid with hydrographic and bathymetric isolines.

11.title: Phase 11: Coastal Shoreline & Beach Crowd Gathering
11.desc: The camera descends smoothly from the coastal surf and breaker foam directly onto the sunlit sandy beach where vibrant crowds are standing by the water's edge.

12.tag: STAGE III // CROWD ON THE BEACH
12.title: Phase 12: Beach Crowd to Central Hero
12.desc: Gliding among the crowds standing on the golden beach sand, casting soft shadows under the sunlight, locking smoothly onto the central hero individual.

13.title: Phase 13: Single Human Head & Cortical Reveal
13.desc: Seamless 1:1 lock onto the hero individual's head and Fibonacci hair whorl on the beach, turning translucent to reveal folded cerebral cortex gyri.

14.title: Phase 14: Cerebral Neural & Synaptic Network
14.desc: Inside the brain's continuous web of pyramidal neurons, branching dendrites, and traveling action-potential flashes.

15.title: Phase 15: Dual Lung Lobes & Bronchial Airway Tree
15.desc: Anatomical bilateral lung lobes expanding with tidal respiration, ribbed cartilaginous trachea, branching fractal bronchi (Murray's Law), and oxygen airflow streams.

16.tag: STAGE III // 3D PULMONARY ALVEOLI & GAS EXCHANGE
16.title: Phase 16: Microscopic 3D Alveoli Sac Clusters & Blood Oxygenation
16.desc: True 3D bulbous grape clusters of inflating alveoli sacs (acini) wrapped in capillary mesh, with red blood cells converting from deoxygenated purple to arterial scarlet as O₂ diffuses.
